title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The correct ratio of lengths for the telescopes must be provided as L_K/L_G = (M + 1)/(M - 1).

title: Magnification Definition
description: Important Criteria: The definition of magnification in terms of the focal lengths of the objective and eyepiece must be correctly stated.

title: Correct Focal Lengths
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between the focal lengths of the eyepieces and the magnification must be correctly derived.

title: Telescope Lengths
description: Important Criteria: The lengths of both telescopes must be correctly expressed in terms of their focal lengths.

title: Reason for Longer Telescope
description: Optional Criteria: A valid reason for preferring the longer telescope despite its length should be provided.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign errors in the magnification equations or focal length relationships must be avoided.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all focal lengths and lengths are expressed in consistent units throughout the solution.
